consequence.statement: New optional flag; no operational consequence stated.

original.statement: A new global CLI flag --redis-compress was added to set redis compression.

decision.reason: [ev-17b4a92134a4] lists this only as a feature that adds a new global `--redis-compress` flag for setting Redis compression. It says nothing about a changed default, removed behaviour, or anything that fails or must be migrated. An optional flag that operators can ignore has no operational consequence, so "none" (informational) is supported. Confidence is low because the excerpt is a one-line changelog entry that does not state outright that existing behaviour is unchanged.
